mainEntity.name: What is the Noble Chef's address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noble Chef is located at 6159 Balboa Ave, San Diego, CA 92111, USA. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

mainEntity.name: Does Noble Chef offer delivery or pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can browse Noble Chef’s menu and place an order for Delivery on DoorDash. Noble Chef does not take orders for Pickup on DoorDash at this time. Noble Chef may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

mainEntity.name: Is Noble Chef a DashPass eligible store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noble Chef is not a DashPass eligible store. You can use the ‘DashPass’ filter on the homepage to find stores on DoorDash that offer DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. You can also look for the DashPass icon next to the store’s name.
